ImageDescription.value:
A die-cut advertising trade card, specifically in a unique hand fan shape. This one was found in a scrapbook, so the back is not visible, but it likely features information about a local business.

A woman in a yellow dress standing at a picture window, surrounded by romantic floral motifs. The title, "A Serenade".

A short poem reads, "How clear By night, In the soft light, Love's song I hear, So near So dear!"

The scrapbook this came from is dated circa 1880s.
